# M1

> Every page of the M1 module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [M1 ABHA identity](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1): M1 base URLs and the operations grouped by use case.
- [M1 APIs](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/apis): The rules that hold across every M1 endpoint. Base URLs, how scope picks the job, RSA encryption, and the two token rule.

- [Get the benefit record for an ABHA number](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-benefit-get-by-abha): Reads the benefit record attached to one ABHA number.
- [Get the state and district recorded against an ABHA number](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-benefit-get-state-district): Used to route a person to the right scheme, since eligibility is often

- [Read the signed in person's ABHA profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-profile-get-account): Needs the `X-token` from login, because it reads one person's account

- [Log the person out and invalidate their user token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-profile-logout): Invalidates the `X-token`. Call it when the person signs out, and when
- [Send an OTP to change something on the profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-profile-request-otp): Raise this before updating a mobile number, an email address or a
- [Update fields on an ABHA profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-profile-update-account): Changes self declared profile details. Changing a mobile number or an
- [Verify the OTP for a profile change](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-profile-verify-otp): Completes the change the OTP was raised for. Send the same `scope` you
- [Receive a patient's shared profile](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-receive-patient-share): Also known as: [HIP Callback] Receive Patient Profile Share.
- [Register / Update HIP-HIU Services (Facility Registry)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-register-hrp-services): Register or update HIP/HIU services in the Facility Registry.
- [Send Email Verification Link](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-send-email-verification-link): Send a one-click email verification link. The user clicks it to verify their email, no OTP required.
- [Get a new user token from a refresh token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/endpoints/m1-token-refresh): Refreshes the `X-token` without making the person log in again. Read the
- [M1 ABHA identity errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m1/errors): What M1 ABHA identity returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
